hypotheses.title: Larch staging preflight requirements and service-specific verification
hypotheses.body: For every Larch staging operation, inspect the complete preflight report, confirm passing results for all staged migration checks, and record the verification identifier before applying any changes. Production deployment is outside the scope of these staging procedures. Verification commands are service-specific: alpha uses `larch verify alpha`, beta uses `larch verify beta`, and gamma uses `larch verify gamma`.
limitations: Applies only to Larch staging in project:e94462115e66ac5997f1fa83; does not define production deployment procedures.
The three verification commands apply to their respective services and are not interchangeable.
